sections.heading: Carried by more than one source

items.title: Supply chain attack on arrayref
items.blurb: What happened On 2026-08-20 at 7:15 UTC we got a report that the proc-macro1 crate was malicious. The Rust Security Response Team verified this to be the case: the crate had a build script that was downloading a malicious payload.

items.title: DRAM Controller Register Manipulation Breaks CPU Memory Isolation
items.blurb: Security researcher Christopher Domas developed skitter-creek-bath-salts, an open-source hardware security tool that disrupts CPU privilege boundaries by manipulating memory controller translation registers.

items.title: S3 Compatibility Doesn't Guarantee S3-Level Security
items.blurb: Security researchers at Wiz recently examined S3-compatible object storage services across six popular neoclouds, revealing significant security gaps compared to Amazon S3.

items.title: Flux Mirror Uses Gitless GitOps to Keep Software Supply Chain Under Control
items.blurb: Flux has introduced Flux Mirror, a CLI plugin that mirrors container images, Helm charts and OCI artifacts between registries from a declarative configuration.

items.title: Cloudflare WriteGuard Brings Fine-Grained Security Controls for MCP Servers
items.blurb: Cloudflare is introducing WriteGuard, now in private beta, to provide fine-grained security controls for MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers.
